title: Hans Christian Andersen Museum
scope: The historic 1799 yellow corner house at Hans Jensens Stræde, opened as part of the Andersen museum in 1908.
limitations: The model represents the historic birthplace only. The 2021 Kengo Kuma museum, garden and Andersen's later childhood home are separate.
Local sill, eave and small rear openings are bounded estimates. The regional elevation raster does not resolve individual cobblestones.
